## Research Completed (Jul 2026 R&D Sessions)

The following gaps from the original audit have been investigated
and resolved — findings documented in `research/r-and-d-v1`:

**H1 — Momentum (REJECTED):** No positive serial autocorrelation
in 1h returns across any volatility regime. BTC does not exhibit
momentum at 1h scale — mean-reversion dominates, especially in LOW_VOL.

**H2 — Liquidity premium (NOT CONCLUSIVE):** Volume-based liquidity
does not predict win rate (p=0.559). Edge is session-dependent
(Europe 08h UTC best) but not liquidity-dependent.

**PnL Attribution (COMPLETE):** Short trades = 100.3% of all PnL.
Edge improves year-over-year (2022: Sharpe 0.73 → 2026: Sharpe 0.92).
Model confidence (p_up) inversely correlated with win rate — confirmed
p_up is ordinal ranking, not calibrated probability.

**Regime Filters (ALL REJECTED):** BULL_AND_HIGHVOL, 16-cell matrix,
Kaufman Efficiency Ratio, MA200 daily — none improved net returns.
The system performs best with NO regime filter and regular retraining.

**Camino A — Symmetric labels (REJECTED):** TP=SL=1.0×ATR system
achieved WR=48.37% (below 50% breakeven), killed by kill-switch.
The model has no directional predictive power without the structural
prior of asymmetric TP/SL.

**Core finding:** S4's edge is a structural mathematical advantage
(TP=2.0×ATR, SL=0.8×ATR gives 71.4% geometric short prior) combined
with EV-gap filtering. The XGBoost model adds marginal signal on top.
Regular retraining (every 14 days) is the single most important
operational variable — not regime filters.

**Simulated performance Oct 2024 – Jul 2026:** +325.7% vs BTC +1.0%,
MaxDD -0.60%, WR 77.0%, across all market regimes.

## Open Research Gaps

### H3 — Funding Rate / Behavioral (PENDING DATA)
Hypothesis: S4 captures predictable behavior of over-leveraged retail
longs in BTC perpetual futures, amplified during European session open
(08h UTC) when institutional flow resolves Asian session imbalances.
Blocked by: OKX API limits to ~3 months of funding rate history.
Requires: Coinglass or CryptoQuant historical data (paid).

### Kaufman Efficiency Ratio as Regime Signal (OPEN QUESTION)
ER past does not predict ER future (r=-0.023, p=0.209).
ER future correlates with outcome but negatively (r=-0.309, p=0.000) —
system wins MORE in choppy markets. Not actionable ex-ante.
Pending: investigate if funding rate extreme predicts ER future.

### Probabilistic Calibration (LOW PRIORITY)
p_up functions as ranking signal. Isotonic/Platt destroys F1.
Requires stable final model before attempting calibration.
Blocked by: model still evolving with retrains.

### PnL Attribution — Remaining (QUICK WIN)
Kelly bucket and day-of-week attribution — ~30 min of work.
FOMC calendar crosscheck — public dates, no cost.

### Microstructure Features (MEDIUM PRIORITY)
OKX fetcher implemented, 697 rows generated.
Features: oi_change_1h, oi_change_8h, oi_zscore_24h,
volume_oi_ratio, funding_rate, funding_sign, funding_extreme.
Pending: integrate into model retrain, reconstruct 2022-2026 history.

### Meta-Regime Filter Deployment (DEPRIORITIZED)
Research showed BULL_AND_HIGHVOL improves Sharpe 0.64→0.73 causally,
but regime filters rejected in R&D as net-negative on total returns.
Revisit only if a specific regime-dependent hypothesis (H3) validates.
